Why the Quran is from God

The Romans

When the Romans lay defeated, the Quran said they would win again within a few years.

Persia took Damascus in 613 and Jerusalem in 614. Rome looked finished. The Quran said the defeated Romans would prevail within a few years. From 622 the emperor Heraclius struck back, and by 628 the Persian king had fallen. Edward Gibbon, a historian who did not accept the prophecy, noted how unlikely it looked when it was said. Scholars discuss the wording and the dates, so weigh it yourself.

﴿غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ٢ فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ٣ فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

The Byzantines have been defeated In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:2-4

You might ask

QuestionCouldn't it just be a lucky guess?
AnswerSome critics say so, since Rome and Persia had traded blows for centuries. What stands out is the timing: a public word at Rome's lowest point, open for anyone to check.Quran · Ar-Rum 30:3
QuestionHow long is a few years?
AnswerThe Arabic word means a small number, and scholars differ on which victory counts. The wording is flexible, which is why this is a sign to weigh, not a verdict.Quran · Ar-Rum 30:4
QuestionHow do we know it came first?
AnswerThe date comes from tradition, and scholars class the sura as from Mecca, before 622. Were it later, the sign would weaken. It is fair to say so.Quran · Ar-Rum 30:2

A forecast made at the lowest moment, and left where anyone could check it.
